build_mask_mvit_model: build a MaskMViT video model with masked autoencoder pretraining for self-supervised learning
create_mae_random_masking: create random per-sample masking on video patch sequences using argsort noise for MAE pretraining
run_mae_forward_encoder: run the MAE encoder to produce masked latent representations with positional embeddings
run_mae_forward_decoder: run the MAE decoder to reconstruct masked patches from latent representations
test_maskfeat_forward: test the maskfeat forward pass that replaces patches with mask tokens and predicts pixel or HOG features
